text.tspan: Literacy rate vs. average years of schooling 2022
Literacy reflects the share of adults who can read and write a simple statement, while average years of
schooling measures completed education (excluding repeated grades) among adults aged 25–65.
Average years of education for 15-64 years olds (years)

tspan.tspan: Where data for 2022 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2002 and 2023 is shown instead.
